name: Terminal
author: Brett
description: Terminal windows with tabs: a root shell in any container (through Container access; protected ones after a confirm), the console's own container, the VPS host over SSH (HOST ROOT), and Claude Code. Open terminal is on every right-click; on a container or folder it opens right there. Mouse mode, standard copy and paste, Mosh mode (server-kept sessions that survive dropped signal), phone key row, idle timeout and a session log. Settings → Plugins → Terminal.
